image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a silver and black computer keyboard. The image focuses on the bottom section, prominently featuring a long, rectangular space bar key in the center of the bottom row. Surrounding keys include modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt) and arrow keys. Below the main key area is a palm rest with a circular fingerprint scanner or power button.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated rectangular key spanning the full width of the bottom keyboard row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is clearly visible as a long, horizontal rectangle extending across the central portion of the bottom row, consistent with standard keyboard layouts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visually, the space bar is significantly longer than adjacent keys (like the arrow keys or modifier keys). While 'ten times' is an approximation, it is visibly the longest key by a large margin, satisfying the relative proportion requirement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is flat or slightly concave.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears flat with a slight matte texture, typical of plastic keyboard keys. No significant convexity or irregular warping is observed.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the key is not visible in this top-down view. Therefore, the stabilizer bar mechanism cannot be verified visually.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Positioned centrally between modifier keys on the bottom row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is located in the center of the bottom alphanumeric row, flanked by what appear to be Ctrl/Alt or similar modifier keys on the left and right.
The key surface shows a non-glossy, diffuse reflection consistent with matte plastic. No high-gloss highlights or metallic sheen are present on the key itself.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Typically white, black, or gray to match keyboard color scheme.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is dark gray/black, matching the surrounding alpha-numeric keys, while the chassis is silver. This fits the standard color scheme description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Part of a standard computer or typewriter keyboard.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surrounding layout (QWERTY-style grid, arrow keys, function row hints) clearly identifies the object as part of a standard computer keyboard.

artifact_observations.location: Keycaps on the upper rows (number row and QWERTY row)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The legends on the smaller keys are illegible smudges or nonsensical shapes rather than crisp letters/numbers. This is a common AI artifact where text generation fails at small scales.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the space bar near the right-arrow key cluster
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the space bar and the adjacent right-arrow/up-arrow keys is slightly blurred and indistinct. The gap spacing is inconsistent compared to the left side, suggesting minor geometric fusion.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom palm rest area and fingerprint scanner
artifact_observations.reasoning: The circular fingerprint scanner appears slightly elliptical and the surrounding bezel has uneven thickness, suggesting a minor perspective warp or symmetry issue in the lower foreground.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the primary subject is indeed a space bar and distinguish it from other elongated keyboard components.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and correctness of the text on the surrounding keys, which showed signs of gibberish.
To check for clean separation between the space bar and adjacent keys, addressing the potential fusion/blurring observed.
To assess general structural coherence and detect any subtle melting or texture anomalies in the plastic surfaces.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between space bar and adjacent arrow/modifier keys
Symmetry and geometry of the palm rest/fingerprint scanner
Consistency of key spacing and alignment
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the smaller keys; AI often generates plausible-looking but nonsensical glyphs. Verify if the space bar's length is proportional to the rest of the keyboard layout or if it appears unnaturally short/long. Check the fingerprint scanner for perfect circularity and bezel symmetry.
